::: {#def-r-squared}
#### Coefficient of determination

The **coefficient of determination** of a fitted model
is one minus the ratio of its [residual sum of squares](#def-rss)
to the [total sum of squares](#def-tss) of its outcomes:

$$R^2 \eqdef 1 - \frac{\text{RSS}}{\text{TSS}}.$$
:::

::: notes
$R^2$ is often described as the proportion of the variation in $Y$
explained by the regression on $X$.
:::
